description: CommonGround plugin hooks (SER-141/143). SessionStart: first-boot detection (nudge to /commonground:initialize when signed in but not connected) and, on an initialized project, a wiki-awareness summary plus a refresh of the team keyword cache. Scoped to "startup" (SER-182): SessionStart also fires on resume/clear/compact, and re-injecting the same orientation block at every compaction is how ambient guidance turns into noise — fixing it at the trigger beats de-duplicating downstream. UserPromptSubmit: the deterministic Code auto-trigger — when a prompt mentions a cached team keyword, nudge Claude to consult the wiki first. Both hooks are self-contained, fail-open, and never break a session.
